steps.name: Sample structure QC and vst transform
steps.question: Do the 60 case and 60 control tumor-biopsy samples separate on a PCA of variance-stabilized counts, and are there outlier samples or batch structure that would confound the downstream signature-survival analysis?

grounding.reason: Sample structure QC: vst(blind), PCA, sample distances, library sizes per R-0033@40bf, applied to the 121x120 Salmon count matrix.

acceptance_criteria: A DESeq2 vst(blind=TRUE) transform is computed on the full raw count matrix (12000 genes x 120 samples)
PCA on the top 500 most-variable genes is plotted and colored by condition (case/control)
A sample-distance heatmap is produced
Library size per sample is reported and any sample far below the median flagged

steps.name: Low-count filter and normalization
steps.question: After removing genes with negligible counts, what is the normalized expression matrix (median-of-ratios / vst) to use as input for signature scoring?

grounding.reason: Minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=60 samples) per R-0002/R-0029, median-of-ratios normalization inside the model per R-0026, since the downstream step is not a limma-voom population-scale DE test but a per-sample signature score.

acceptance_criteria: Genes are kept if they reach at least 10 counts in at least 60 samples (the smallest group size)
DESeq2 median-of-ratios size factors are computed and used for normalization (no ad hoc pre-scaling of the raw counts)
The vst-transformed, filtered matrix is saved for the signature-scoring step
The number of genes retained after filtering is reported, and the presence of the 20 signature genes in the retained set is confirmed

steps.name: UCell signature score per sample
steps.question: What is the per-sample rank-based score of the study's 20-gene signature (signature_genes.csv) across all 120 tumor biopsy samples, and how many of the 20 genes are present in the filtered expression matrix?

grounding.reason: UCell rank-based per-sample scoring is the default for a single unweighted gene-list signature per R-0133; the score-vs-condition t-test and provenance reporting follow R-0134.

acceptance_criteria: UCell computes one rank-based signature score per sample from the vst-transformed, filtered expression matrix using the 20 genes in signature_genes.csv
The number and identity of signature genes found vs missing in the matrix is reported explicitly

The score distribution is summarized overall and by condition (case vs control) with a t-test (two-group, no covariate) purely as a descriptive check of confounding, not as the primary inferential test
Signature source, version note (20-gene, unweighted, as provided), and gene count present are stated in the output

steps.name: Cox proportional hazards model of the signature score adjusted for case/control
steps.question: Does the UCell signature score associate with time to the recorded event (metadata columns time and event) once case versus control status is included as a covariate in the same Cox model, across the 120-sample cohort?

grounding.reason: Cox model with the score as a continuous term and clinical covariates (condition) in the same model, PH check via scaled Schoenfeld residuals, per R-0153; validated/caveated per R-0154 since no external cohort exists here.

acceptance_criteria: A Cox proportional hazards model is fit with time-to-event and event indicator as the outcome, the continuous (uncut) UCell signature score as the primary term, and condition (case/control) as a covariate in the same model
The metadata file is inspected directly for any additional clinical covariates (e.g., age, stage) beyond condition, time, and event; if present, they are added to the model and the decision is stated

The proportional hazards assumption is checked via scaled Schoenfeld residuals for the score term and the condition term; if violated, a stratified or time-varying-effect model is reported instead of the single hazard ratio
Hazard ratio per unit of the signature score is reported with its 95% confidence interval and p-value, together with the number of events, the number of samples, and the covariates in the model
A Kaplan-Meier curve stratified by score tertile is produced for visualization only, with the stated caveat that inference rests on the continuous Cox model, not the KM stratification
The report explicitly states that this is an internal, non-externally-validated association (no independent validation cohort exists in this environment)

steps.name: Synthesis report
steps.question: What is the combined evidence, across QC, signature scoring, and the Cox survival model, for or against an association between the 20-gene signature score and time-to-event independent of case/control status?

grounding.reason: Reproducibility record requirement per R-0086; the synthesis narrative itself has no specific rule and is planner-composed.

acceptance_criteria: Report integrates the QC findings (sample structure, any outliers), the signature score distribution and its relationship to condition, and the Cox model hazard ratio, CI, p-value, and PH diagnostic for the score term
Report states clearly whether the score's association with the outcome survives adjustment for condition, and flags any confounding where score and condition are strongly associated with each other
Reproducibility record included: package versions, session info, any random seeds used, and the version/provenance of the 20-gene signature list

plan.title: 20-gene signature score vs time-to-event, adjusted for case/control
plan.analytical_narrative: The cohort is 60 cases vs 60 controls with raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 121 columns incl. gene symbol) and a metadata table carrying condition, time, and event per sample (120 x 4). The question is whether a per-sample score of the study's 20-gene signature associates with time-to-event once case/control status is accounted for. This requires: (1) standard QC and normalization of the count matrix to establish a variance-stabilized, log-scale expression matrix; (2) a minimal low-count pre-filter; (3) a per-sample rank-based signature score (UCell) computed from the 20 signature genes against the vst-transformed expression, with an explicit check of how many of the 20 signature genes are actually present in the matrix; (4) a descriptive comparison of the score between cases and controls (t-test/limma) purely as a sample-structure sanity check, since the score's association with the condition is the confound the survival model must adjust for; (5) the central analysis, a Cox proportional hazards model of time-to-event on the continuous signature score with case/control status included as a covariate in the same model, with a proportional-hazards check via scaled Schoenfeld residuals, reporting the hazard ratio per unit score, its 95% CI, and the covariate-adjusted effect; and (6) a synthesis report with the reproducibility record. The design has a single batch and no other declared covariates, so the Cox model includes only score + condition; if the metadata carries additional clinical covariates not captured in the profile summary, the modeling step will inspect the metadata file directly and include them if present. Because there are 120 events/censoring records against roughly 60+60 samples, the proportional-hazards model is adequately powered for a two-covariate Cox fit; no external validation cohort exists in this environment, so the survival result is reported as an internal, non-externally-validated association per the grounded procedure.

steps.method: Median-of-ratios size factors (DESeq2 normalization) / vst for scoring input
UCell rank-based signature scores per sample on the 20-gene signature
Cox proportional hazards model: score + condition, with PH check via scaled Schoenfeld residuals
